firmware.note: CircuitPython on the board, fox-bench's foxlib and a network-fox template (Wi-Fi beacon, Wi-Fi probe, BLE beacon, puzzle beacon, checkpoint) deployed over the REPL, as source or precompiled .mpy. The SoC's own radio: no module. The board variant sets the CircuitPython build and the LED / battery pins; a connected board's reported id picks it. All five templates on the bench on the XIAO ESP32S3 (Sense) 2026-11-17/23, found by a phone and by the laptop, the checkpoint's sign-in page and find log included (docs/hardware-log.md). The S3-Nano variant is described from the Arduino Nano ESP32 build and not yet run.
